issue.title: Taxonomic hierarchy incorrect for certain cases

summary.text: The verifier found counterexamples: the fixed parse_tax_lvl raises NameError: name 're' is not defined (the fix appears to use the re module without importing it), parse_kraken_report also breaks on a crafted report, and 14 previously passing tests in test_parsing.py, test_biom_create.py and test_process_samples.py now fail. Look first at the missing 're' import in kraken_biom and rerun those tes…
